import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')
data = data.dropna()
# IDW interpolation using alkalinity/mg_content to predict proline_content
X = data[['alkalinity', 'mg_content']].values
y = data['proline_content'].values

tree = cKDTree(X)
dists, idxs = tree.query(X, k=4)
weights = 1.0 / (dists[:, 1:] + 1e-10)
predicted = (weights * y[idxs[:, 1:]]).sum(axis=1) / weights.sum(axis=1)
print({'key': 'idw_predicted_value_1', 'value': round(float(predicted[0]), 2)})
print({'key': 'idw_predicted_value_2', 'value': round(float(predicted[1]), 2)})
